name: Sunrise Plumbing & Repair
description: Family-owned plumbing service with over 20 years of experience. We specialize in leak repairs, pipe replacement, and bathroom fixture installation. Licensed, insured, and always on time.

name: Bright Home Electrical
description: Certified electricians available 7 days a week for safety inspections, outlet repairs, and lighting upgrades. We treat every home as if it were our own. Free estimates for seniors.

name: Gentle Hands Home Care
description: Compassionate caregivers providing personal care, companionship, meal preparation, and medication reminders. All staff are background-checked and CPR certified. Available 24/7.

name: Spotless Home Cleaning
description: Professional cleaning services tailored for seniors. We use non-toxic, fragrance-free products safe for those with sensitivities. Weekly, bi-weekly, and one-time deep clean options available.

name: SafeRide Senior Transport
description: Door-to-door transportation for medical appointments, grocery shopping, and social outings. Wheelchair-accessible vehicles available. Friendly drivers trained in senior assistance.

name: Lawn & Garden Pros
description: Reliable lawn mowing, hedge trimming, leaf removal, and garden maintenance. Affordable seasonal packages for seniors. Fully insured and locally operated for over 12 years.

name: Handy Harold Home Repairs
description: From leaky faucets to broken doors, Harold handles small repairs quickly and affordably. No job too small. Trust built on 15 years of five-star service in the community.

name: TechHelp Senior Tech Support
description: Patient, in-home help with smartphones, tablets, computers, and smart TVs. We explain everything clearly with no jargon. Perfect for seniors wanting to stay connected with family.

name: Meals by Maria
description: Fresh, home-cooked meals delivered daily. Heart-healthy, diabetic-friendly, and low-sodium options available. All meals made from scratch with fresh local ingredients. No preservatives.

name: SecureHome Lock & Security
description: Simple, easy-to-use home security systems designed with seniors in mind. Medical alert integration, door sensors, and camera installation. Monitoring starts at just $19/month.
